title: mimi-mls: external AppDataUpdate cannot carry SafeAAD
description: Found while doing mimid-1wgh.4.9. OpenMLS AuthenticatedContent::new_external_proposal (openmls/src/framing/mls_auth_content.rs:196 at 24f3eb6) hardcodes an empty authenticated_data, and ExternalProposal::new_app_data_update has no AAD parameter. mls-extensions-10 section 4.9 (txt lines 809-813, 900-904) says that once the GroupContext app_data_dictionary carries safe_aad, authenticated_data always starts with a SafeAAD struct (an empty one is the byte 0x00). So in a safe_aad room (real MIMI rooms carry it; hub/submit.rs:280 requires SafeAAD) every receiver rejects the hub's external proposal: confirmed, check_safe_aad fails with EndOfStream. Observer::propose_app_update therefore fails closed with ObserverError::SafeAadRequired. Options: (A) extend the openmls fork so new_app_data_update (or new_external_proposal) takes authenticated_data, and pass EMPTY SafeAAD 0x00; (B) hand-frame the external PublicMessage in mimi-mls (FramedContent + SignWithLabel FramedContentTBS, RFC 9420 section 6.1; about 30 lines) without the OpenMLS builder. Recommendation: A, since it keeps framing in OpenMLS and is a natural part of the upstream report. Mark decides; any openmls write needs his approval.
notes:
DECIDED 2026-10-19 (Mark): option A, an authenticated_data parameter in the openmls fork (branch mimid-0.9.1); fork change approved, push needs a separate OK. .4.9 lands together with this fix, not before.
2026-10-19: option A done. Fork commit a36719847c81a7722cadf21462995077a6325632 on /home/mark/GIT/openmls mimid-0.9.1, LOCAL ONLY, NOT PUSHED: ExternalProposal::new_app_data_update gains authenticated_data: Vec<u8>; new pub(crate) AuthenticatedContent::new_external_proposal_with_aad, existing new_external_proposal delegates with empty AAD (Add/Remove/GCE builders unchanged). 2 tests pass vec![], new test external_app_data_update_proposal_authenticated_data_is_signed. cargo test -p openmls: plain 360 pass; with extensions-draft,extensions-draft-test-dependencies 422 pass (termion stubbed via --config, not committed). mimid worktree uses file:// patch for testing; awaiting Mark's push approval then GitHub URL switch.
